issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement and UML declare a method with signature addGuestStudents(int) (single int parameter). The template starter code declares addGuestStudents with signature addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (an extra boolean parameter). The reference solution implements addGuestStudents(int). This disagreement between template and specification/solution will confuse students about the expected API and can cause compilation or test integration problems (students following the spec will implement a method signature not present in the template, or will have to modify the provided template).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution by changing the template method declaration to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* TODO */ }. If the extra boolean parameter was intentionally required, update the problem statement and UML to specify the boolean parameter (and update the solution accordingly). Alternatively, provide both an overloaded method (int) and an (int, boolean) variant in the template and document the intended primary signature to avoid student confusion.
